character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A goblin chieftain, the biggest goblin of the warband: taller and broader than the other goblins but with the same goblin build, wiry long arms, a hunched stance, bright olive-green skin, long pointed ears, a tusked grin. Carries a big maul over its shoulder: a square stone head banded in brass with a glowing violet rune, a leather-wrapped wooden haft. A necklace of small bones, a wide leather belt with a brass gear-wheel buckle, a short ragged cape of fur and torn blue academy banners with gold stars, leather bracers, bare clawed feet. Bold readable pixel art, chunky shapes, dark outline.
